text: This staff report is about a matter for which Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to amend the weekday, daytime parking prohibitions on both sides of Cartwright Avenue, between Jane Osler Boulevard and Dufferin Street, to include the weekends. The proposed parking prohibitions will address the concerns of the residents on Cartwright Avenue regarding excessive parking in front of their properties during weekends.

North York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the north side of Cartwright Avenue, between Jane Osler Boulevard (south intersection) and a point 91.5 metres west of Dufferin Street, to operate 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect from 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the south side of Cartwright Avenue, between a point opposite the easterly limit of Jane Osler Boulevard and Dufferin Street, to operate 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., daily.
